question: How do employer-sponsored retirement accounts differ from individual retirement accounts (IRAs)?
answer: Employer-sponsored accounts are offered through plans such as 401(k), 403(b), and 457(b) plans. An IRA can be opened by the investor at a vendor of their choice. Depending on their circumstances, a person may have more than one type of retirement account.
